directions.caution: You sent to no creators last month, so this is new for you and results can vary.
directions.plain: You send free pieces to small creators. They share photos wearing your pieces with their followers.
directions.title: Send Pieces To Small Creators
directions.why_for_you: Creator posts earn more love than your own posts, and most creators you send to do post.
directions.you_would_do: Message about twenty small creators, send pieces to those who reply, and post three to five times with mostly close-ups.

directions.caution: Sales pull future buys forward, so use this only now and then.
directions.plain: You pick one week for a simple price cut. Shoppers who were waiting decide to buy now.
directions.title: Run One Simple Discount Week
directions.why_for_you: Sales have lifted you a lot in the past, and you were close to your goal last month with no spend.
directions.you_would_do: Pick one sale week, tell followers clearly, and post four to five times with mostly close-ups.

directions.plain: You post often with no spend. It is slow and safe and builds trust over time.
directions.title: Keep Posting Great Photos Weekly
directions.why_for_you: Your close-up photos get the most love, and you were close to your goal last month with no spend.
directions.you_would_do: Post four to five times a week using mostly close-ups and on-hand shots.

directions.caution: You spent nothing on ads last month, so this is untested for you and ad prices are high now.
directions.plain: You put money behind your best photos. More young women see them right away.
directions.title: Boost Best Posts With Ads
directions.why_for_you: Your close-up photos get the most love, so they give ads something strong to share.
directions.you_would_do: Post three to five times with your best close-ups and put ad money behind the top posts.

season_note: November has average demand at 1.00 but higher ad costs at 1.18, so posts, creators, and a short sale make your budget go further.
